linear_wire_resistance_diagnosis.interpretation: 1A is a mathematical test excitation of unchanged linear R network only, not actual device current. Energy contributions equal R*i^2; sensitivities identify wire resistors whose physical reduction can reduce DC effective R. Other terminals float in this calculation. This is not the multi-terminal operating point, transient delay, effective device loading, EM current, extracted RF qualification or a new acceptance gate. Original failed waveform results remain authoritative.

parts.meaning: Concatenate strictly in index order; verify every part and combined SHA256 before extracting. No original waveform samples removed.
